name: AI-Native Fixed Flow
description: Cursor Agent 自动化任务执行流程 - 配置化版本
author: Pipeline-Sys

task_pack_path.description: TaskPack 文件路径（可选，不提供则自动生成）

skip_git.description: 是否跳过 Git 提交（默认跳过，人工提交）

taskpack_path.description: 实际使用的 TaskPack 路径

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.description: 初始化运行参数，记录到 00_intake.json
nodes.expression: ({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, role: inputs.role, task_type: inputs.task_type, complexity: inputs.complexity, model_override: inputs.model_override, project_root: inputs.project_root, received_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: Git 预检
nodes.description: 检查工作区状态，确保可以执行
nodes.command: git fetch origin main && git status --porcelain && echo '---BRANCH---' && git branch --show-current && echo '---HEAD---' && git rev-parse HEAD

nodes.name: 准备计划输入
nodes.description: 构建 AI 执行计划的输入数据
nodes.expression: (() => { return JSON.stringify({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, outcome: inputs.outcome || '', task_type: inputs.task_type, complexity: inputs.complexity, role: inputs.role, git_status: (nodes['stage.preflight'].output.stdout || '').slice(0, 500) }); })()

nodes.name: AI 生成执行计划
nodes.description: 调用 cursor-agent 生成智能执行计划

nodes.name: 降级执行计划
nodes.expression: ({ task_type: inputs.task_type || 'code', complexity: inputs.complexity || 'normal', estimated_duration_minutes: 60, steps: [], required_tools: ['cursor-agent'], potential_blockers: [], success_criteria: ['任务完成'], summary: '使用默认执行计划' })

nodes.name: 解析计划结果
nodes.expression: (() => { try { const stdout = nodes.ai_generate_plan && nodes.ai_generate_plan.output ? nodes.ai_generate_plan.output.stdout : ''; if (!stdout) throw new Error('No output'); const result = JSON.parse(stdout); return { task_type: result.task_type || inputs.task_type || 'code', complexity: result.complexity || inputs.complexity || 'normal', estimated_duration_minutes: result.estimated_duration_minutes || 60, steps: result.steps || [], required_tools: result.required_tools || [], potential_blockers: result.potential_blockers || [], success_criteria: result.success_criteria || [], summary: result.summary || '' }; } catch(e) { return { task_type: inputs.task_type || 'code', complexity: inputs.complexity || 'normal', estimated_duration_minutes: 60, steps: [], required_tools: [], potential_blockers: [], success_criteria: [], summary: '解析失败' }; } })()

nodes.name: 整合执行计划
nodes.description: 整合 AI 或 fallback 的执行计划
nodes.expression: (() => { const plan = nodes.parse_plan_result ? nodes.parse_plan_result.output : (nodes.fallback_plan ? nodes.fallback_plan.output : {}); return { ok: true, planned_at: new Date().toISOString(), role: inputs.role, task_type: plan.task_type || inputs.task_type, complexity: plan.complexity || inputs.complexity, model_override: inputs.model_override, runner: 'wsl-runner-v2', ai_plan: plan }; })()

nodes.name: 检查 TaskPack
nodes.description: 检查是否提供了 TaskPack，否则生成

nodes.name: 准备 TaskPack 输入
nodes.description: 构建 AI TaskPack 生成的输入数据
nodes.expression: (() => { return JSON.stringify({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, outcome: inputs.outcome || '', task_type: inputs.task_type, complexity: inputs.complexity, role: inputs.role }); })()

nodes.name: AI 生成 TaskPack
nodes.description: 调用 cursor-agent 生成详细 TaskPack

nodes.name: 降级 TaskPack 生成
nodes.expression: (() => { return { task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, task_type: inputs.task_type || 'code', complexity: inputs.complexity || 'normal', outcome: inputs.outcome || '-', allowed_inputs: ['./'], deliverables: ['待定'], constraints: ['不得修改冻结目录'], acceptance_checklist: ['交付物落盘'], recommended_role: inputs.role || 'L3_engineer', estimated_hours: 4 }; })()

nodes.name: 解析 TaskPack 结果
nodes.expression: (() => { try { const stdout = nodes.ai_compose_taskpack && nodes.ai_compose_taskpack.output ? nodes.ai_compose_taskpack.output.stdout : ''; if (!stdout) throw new Error('No output'); const result = JSON.parse(stdout); return { task_id: result.task_id || inputs.task_id, title: result.title || inputs.title, task_type: result.task_type || inputs.task_type || 'code', complexity: result.complexity || inputs.complexity || 'normal', outcome: result.outcome || inputs.outcome || '-', allowed_inputs: result.allowed_inputs || ['./'], deliverables: result.deliverables || ['待定'], constraints: result.constraints || ['不得修改冻结目录'], acceptance_checklist: result.acceptance_checklist || ['交付物落盘'], recommended_role: result.recommended_role || inputs.role || 'L3_engineer', estimated_hours: result.estimated_hours || 4 }; } catch(e) { return { task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, task_type: 'code', complexity: 'normal', outcome: '-', allowed_inputs: ['./'], deliverables: ['待定'], constraints: ['不得修改冻结目录'], acceptance_checklist: ['交付物落盘'], recommended_role: 'L3_engineer', estimated_hours: 4 }; } })()

nodes.name: 写入 TaskPack
nodes.description: 将 AI 生成的 TaskPack 写入文件
nodes.command:
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const tp = ${JSON.stringify(nodes.parse_taskpack_result ? nodes.parse_taskpack_result.output : nodes.fallback_compose_taskpack.output)}; const fileName = tp.task_id + '_task.md'; const relPath = 'design/ai-native/03_taskpacks/' + fileName; const content = ['---', 'task_id: ' + tp.task_id, 'title: "' + (tp.title || '').replace(/"/g, '') + '"', 'task_type: ' + tp.task_type, 'complexity: ' + tp.complexity, 'model_override: auto', 'execution_runtime: wsl', 'requires_mcp: false', '---', '', '# TASK-PACK: ' + tp.task_id, '', '## 1. Outcome', tp.outcome, '', '## 2. Allowed Inputs', tp.allowed_inputs.map(i => '- ' + i).join('
'), '', '## 3. Deliverables', tp.deliverables.map(d => '- ' + d).join('
'), '', '## 4. Constraints', tp.constraints.map(c => '- ' + c).join('
'), '', '## 5. Acceptance Checklist', tp.acceptance_checklist.map(a => '- [ ] ' + a).join('
'), ''].join('
'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(relPath), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(relPath, content); console.log(relPath);"

nodes.name: Cursor Agent 执行
nodes.description: 调用 Cursor CLI 执行代码编辑任务
nodes.command: TASKPACK_PATH="${inputs.task_pack_path}"; if [ -z "$TASKPACK_PATH" ] && [ -n "${nodes.execute.compose_taskpack.output.stdout}" ]; then TASKPACK_PATH=$(echo "${nodes.execute.compose_taskpack.output.stdout}" | tr -d '\n'); fi; bash workflows/project/tools/run-cursor-task.sh --task-pack "$TASKPACK_PATH" --task-type "${inputs.task_type}" --complexity "${inputs.complexity}" --model-override "${inputs.model_override}"

nodes.name: 代码检查
nodes.description: 运行 lint 和类型检查
nodes.command: if [ -f game/package.json ]; then cd game && npm run lint --if-present; else echo 'No package.json found, skipping validate'; fi || true

nodes.name: 测试验证
nodes.description: 运行测试套件（如果存在）
nodes.command: if [ -f game/package.json ]; then cd game && npm run test --if-present; else echo 'No package.json found, skipping test'; fi || true

nodes.name: 生成执行摘要
nodes.expression: ({ edit_ok: nodes['execute.edit'] && nodes['execute.edit'].status === 'SUCCESS', lint_exit: nodes['execute.lint'] ? nodes['execute.lint'].output.exitCode : null, test_exit: nodes['execute.test'] ? nodes['execute.test'].output.exitCode : null, summary: 'Edit: ' + (nodes['execute.edit'] && nodes['execute.edit'].status === 'SUCCESS' ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') })

nodes.name: 检查是否跳过 Git
nodes.description: 根据 skip_git 参数决定是否执行 Git 提交

nodes.name: Git 提交推送
nodes.description: 提交变更并推送到远程
nodes.command: git add -A && git diff --cached --name-only && git commit -m "${inputs.task_id}: ${inputs.title} [v2-flow]" && git push origin HEAD || echo 'No changes to commit'
